newsitem.title: ITALY: Gross yields fall at Italian Btp bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Gross yields fall at Italian Btp bond auction.

text.p: Auction results for a seventh tranche of 2.5 trillion lire worth of three-year Italian Treasury fixed rate bonds (Btp) with an 7.50 pct coupon, and a seventh tranche of 2.0 trillion lire of five-year Btps carrying a 7.75 pct coupon.
Net Yield 5.18 pct 5.72 pct 5.53 pct 6.10 pct
Gross Yield 6.13 pct 6.67 pct 6.50 pct 7.09 pct
Note - Comparisons are with a previous auction on Oct 31 of a fifth tranche of three and five-year Btps.
